### CLI

| | |
|---|---|
| [apg cache](inspect_cache.qmd) | Manage the AgentProvingGround model cache. |
| [apg eval-retry](inspect_eval-retry.qmd) | Retry an evaluation task. |
| [apg eval-set](inspect_eval-set.qmd) | Evaluate a set of tasks with retries. |
| [apg eval](inspect_eval.qmd) | Evaluate one or more tasks. |
| [apg info](inspect_info.qmd) | Read version and configuration. |
| [apg list](inspect_list.qmd) | List tasks on the filesystem. |
| [apg log](inspect_log.qmd) | Query, read, write, and convert logs. |
| [apg sandbox](inspect_sandbox.qmd) | Manage sandbox environments. |
| [apg score](inspect_score.qmd) | Score a previous evaluation run. |
| [apg trace](inspect_trace.qmd) | List and read execution traces. |
| [apg view](inspect_view.qmd) | AgentProvingGround log viewer. |
: {.borderless tbl-colwidths=[35,65]}
